messages.subject: Package Dependency & vioplot
parts:
* I installed the vioplot package from within RStudio 0.98.1091, as confirmed by the installation log below:

> install.packages("vioplot")
trying URL 'http://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/contrib/3.1/vioplot_0.2.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 10864 bytes (10 Kb)
opened URL
==================================================
downloaded 10 Kb

The downloaded binary packages are in
/var/folders/mL/mLHC18ZDGvCHQC+0UiALGU+++TI/-Tmp-//RtmpT9xyvq/downloaded_packages
==================================================


* I load library(vioplot) and have no problem using it to display violin plots when I test it on my local server.


* But when I attempt to deploy, I get an error (below) that vioplot was not installed from CRAN, despite the fact that I d/loaded it from the CRAN site:


> deployApp(appDir = getwd(), appName = 'myApp')
Preparing to deploy application...
Uploading application bundle...

Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'vioplot'
  
  The package was installed locally from source. Only packages installed from
  CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub are supported.

I don't understand why shinyapps thinks vioplot was installed 'locally from source' when -- as far as I can see -- it was installed from CRAN -- and will appreciate some guidance.
